errorCodes.meaning: The witness declines to open a session — policy, capacity, or the named exchange is not one it will witness.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The session challenge, issued under the REQUIRED proof. The presentation under witness/session/submit binds to {challenge, domain}. It reaches only the party that opened this session — which is why each party opens its own.

challenge.description: A fresh, unpredictable, single-use value this session's presentation binds to. A witness MUST NOT reuse a challenge across sessions — including across the two sessions of one witnessed exchange, where a shared value would let either party's presentation satisfy the other's session.

domain.description: The domain the presentations bind alongside the challenge, identifying this witness's verification context.

schema.description: Opens one participating party's witness session as its own exchange, nested in a relationship exchange via parentThreadId. A session is bilateral — a witnessed exchange between two parties runs two sessions with the same witness, each naming the same parties pair. The response issues the session challenge; the request document's id is the value that party's VWC later carries as taskContext.

parties.description: The relationship DIDs of the exchange to be witnessed — the pairwise values the relationship proposal exchanged, in either order.
